test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 14 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: For Rajya Sabha membership, the President nominates __________members on the basis of their excellence in literature, science, art and social service and the rest are elected.
solution:
The correct answer is __**12**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The main contribution of members is to provide support towards arts, literature, sciences, and social services.
 
• The Rajya Sabha should consist of a maximum of 250 members.
 
• Out of a total of 250 members, 238 members are representing the States and Union Territories and 12 members are nominated by the President.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rajya Sabha is a permanent body that cannot be dissolved.

 
 
• However, one-third of its members retire every second year and are replaced by newly elected members for the next six years.
 
 
 
• The Vice-President of India is the Chairman of the Rajya Sabha.​
 
• In Rajya Sabha, twelve members are nominated by the President of India for a period of six years.
